coverage: Partial official-source coverage: selected USD releases from BEA, Federal Reserve and BLS (some BLS records use the labeled FRED fallback); ECB euro-area statistics; selected ONS UK releases; selected Statistics Canada and Bank of Canada releases; selected Australian Bureau of Statistics releases; RBNZ and Stats NZ releases; selected Bank of Japan releases; and selected SNB events. This is not an exhaustive calendar for any currency. Impact is an editorial app classification; all displayed event times include an IANA timezone.

bea.coverage: US Bureau of Economic Analysis official schedule; retained upcoming releases reviewed

bls.coverage: Selected BLS releases; current records rely on FRED fallback and remain labeled

fed-news.coverage: Federal Reserve official news feed; headlines paraphrased with source publication dates

rbnz.coverage: Reserve Bank of New Zealand official MPS event calendar

stats-nz.coverage: Stats NZ official release calendar and GDP indicator

boj.coverage: Bank of Japan official release schedule

snb.coverage: Swiss National Bank official event schedule
